🔴🔵 MATCHDAY! IT’S GOOD TO BE HOME! ❤️🐎

Today we remember Jack Evans with a minute’s silence and raise awareness of men’s mental health. ❤️

We welcome league leaders Sandbach United. Kick-off 2pm at the Theatre of Jockeys!

CMON DAWLEY ❤️

Finally we are pleased to now offer Replica Home and Away jerseys

Available to pre order at todays game

Come and see Bakes in clubhouse who will take payment and details 

Up the Jockeys https://t.co/z80UU0DBg8
Back at TF4 on Halloween 🐎 https://t.co/4f7EcyJzOb

🔴🔵 v 🟡🟡

Dawley Town v Sandbach United

@DawleyTownFC 

Another tough away fixture for The Bach today, all being well a solid performance and a win, but nothing taken for granted and the lads will need to be right on it to take anything away from the game. Up The Bach!
Sandbach line up for today’s early kickoff against @DawleyTownFC 2pm KO. https://t.co/g5QHApArqa
Here’s how your Jockeys lineup against Sandbach United in what proves to be a great day! Get down and support the lads! 2PM 🐎 https://t.co/XnjVExMwVj

Dawley Town v Sandbach United

@DawleyTownFC 

Match underway here as The Bach don their dayglo yellow strip and see Harry Cain make the starting 11 and Kieran O’Connell and Stan Tatters back in after suspension and injury respectively 

0 0
